prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: Building on c007 (timing-driven net weighting enabled, +0.423), the partitioner currently only balances total area; extending `_refine_partition_by_area`'s tolerance to 0.20 (c008) helped ariane but hurt the others because it lets the refinement stop early. Instead, keep area_balance_error at the baseline 0.10 (c008's loosening was the regression source) and additionally let the refinement *overshoot* balance only when it reduces the number of macros moved — i.e. tighten the loop by preferring the single largest-area swap that lands within tolerance rather than the first improving one. This reduces needless macro flips that scatter critical macros across tiers, keeping timing-driven placement's critical nets short.
Rule-based digest:
total=-inf robust(mean-std)=-inf min_case=-inf all_valid=False
  failures: bp_fe-ng45/1001:legalization overlap; bp_fe-ng45/1002:stage timeout; bp_fe-ng45/1003:HBT min-spacing violation; bp-ng45/1001:HBT min-spacing violation; bp-ng45/1002:legalization overlap; bp-ng45/1003:legalization overlap
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: Invalid: legality failures (legalization overlap, HBT min-spacing) plus one stage timeout, spanning all seeds of both bp_fe-ng45 and bp-ng45 — systematic, so this candidate says nothing about the hypothesis. Likely the tighter tolerance/overshoot logic produces placements the legalizer can't resolve. To make the idea legal: keep area_balance_error at 0.10 but gate the "prefer largest-area swap" rule behind a post-refine legality check, and add a fallback that reverts to the first-improving swap if legalization fails. Re-run before judging timing.
